faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for KV Shamgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for KV Shamgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for KV Shamgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Required qualification for Trained Graduate Teacher (Maths) as given on the KVS website https://kvsangathan.nic.in/ and https://shamgarh.kvs.ac.in/.

faq.question: Q4. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Class teaching (demonstration). Interview. Selection on the basis of class teaching / interview.

faq.question: Q6. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely part-time contractual engagement, as and when required. Panel prepared for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
Q8. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Original certificates; Mark sheets; Photocopies of original documents.
